description: This PHP trait provides methods to manage SDG (Sustainable Development Goals) relationships within models. It includes functionalities for adding, replacing, retrieving, and removing SDGs associated with a model that has dedicated relationship tables following specific naming conventions.

methods.name: getSdgRelationalTable
methods.description: Returns the name of the relationship table for SDGs, based on the current model's table name.

methods.name: addSdgs
methods.description: Adds one or multiple SDGs to the model, with optional removal of others.

methods.name: replaceSdgs
methods.description: Replaces all existing SDGs with a new set.

methods.name: getSdgs
methods.description: Retrieves associated SDGs, optionally localized by language.

methods.name: removeSdgs
methods.description: Removes specified SDGs from the model.

methods.name: getMainSdg
methods.description: Returns the primary SDG associated with the model, if any.
